Arrange plots at a fixed physical panel size

Source: R/plot_panel_layout.R
arrange_weather_panels.Rd

Tries column counts in order, measures the complete canvas, and selects the first grid fitting the width limit. Panels fill rows from left to right. Text and marks are never scaled to fit. Empty trailing cells remain empty.

Usage

arrange_weather_panels(
  plots,
  panel_width_mm = 70,
  panel_height_mm = 70,
  preferred_columns = c(3L, 2L),
  max_width_mm = 180,
  dpi = 300,
  single_panel_heading = FALSE,
  repeat_y_title = TRUE
)

Arguments

plots

Nonempty list of single-panel ggplots.

panel_width_mm, panel_height_mm

Positive plotting-area dimensions.

preferred_columns

Ordered distinct integers of at least two.

max_width_mm

Maximum complete canvas width, including decorations.

dpi

Resolution of the temporary measurement device.

single_panel_heading

Whether to retain a single panel's facet heading. Units should also be present in axis labels when the heading is omitted.

repeat_y_title

Whether to repeat y-axis titles outside the first column.

Value

A patchwork with millimetre measurements in its weathergenr_panel_layout attribute and stored automatic export geometry.

Examples

p <- ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(wt, mpg)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() + theme_weathergenr(base_size = 7)
panels <- arrange_weather_panels(list(p, p))
